init_llamaguard: initialize a LlamaGuard content moderation instance with a custom model name and unsafe content categories file
set_custom_prompt_template: register a LlamaGuard prompt template with litellm to check conversation messages for unsafe content
async_moderation_hook: run an async moderation hook that calls LlamaGuard to reject requests violating the content safety policy
print_verbose: debug print a statement using the verbose proxy logger when litellm verbose mode is enabled
review_llamaguard_class: review the _ENTERPRISE_LlamaGuard class to understand how it extends CustomLogger for content moderation
